column3: “Kept back from before Saul” is rendered “restricted because of Saul,” and NASB supplies “him.”
NASB supplies “both,” “to sling,” and “to shoot”; “relatives” is rendered “kinsmen.”
“The sons of the Shemaahite” is rendered “the sons of Shemaah.” NASB adds “then.”
MT 12:9. “Separated themselves” is rendered “came over,” and “preparing shield and spear” as “who could handle shield and spear”; “to hastening” is rendered “swift.”
MT 12:15. “Chiefs of the army” is rendered “captains of the army,” and the brief Hebrew comparison is filled out (“he who was least was equal to a hundred”).
MT 12:18. “Went out before them” is rendered “went out to meet them,” and “a heart for unity” as “my heart shall be united with you”; “violence” is rendered “wrong.”
MT 12:19. “Clothed Amasai” is rendered “came upon Amasai,” and “chief of the officers” (written text) as “chief of the thirty.” NASB supplies “he said” and “We are.”
MT 12:20. “Fell on David” is rendered “defected to David,” and “by plan” as “after consultation.”
MT 12:21. “Fell on him” is rendered “defected to him”; NASB spells “Adnah.”
MT 12:30. “Keeping the duty” is rendered “kept their allegiance.”
MT 12:31. “Men of names” is rendered “famous men.”
